name: Mana Community - Metro Feeder Shuttle Capacity & Frequency Arbitrator

parameters.jsCode:
const item = $input.first().json.body || $input.first().json;
const prompt = "You are an autonomous transit dispatch AI for Mana Community metro feeder shuttles.
You analyze hourly resident shuttle bookings, predict peak overcrowding, and optimize departure intervals (every 10m vs 20m).
Analyze the input payload:
__DATA__

Respond strictly with valid JSON conforming to this schema:
{
  "shuttleRouteId": "SHTL-METRO-01",
  "routeName": "Community Gate 1 <-> Metro Station Feeder",
  "projectedOccupancyPct": 92.5,
  "capacityRisk": "HIGH_SURGE_RISK",
  "recommendedFrequencyMinutes": 10,
  "deployBackupShuttle": true,
  "optimalDepartureWindow": "08:00 AM - 09:30 AM",
  "passengerSafetyDirectives": [
    "Deploy 24-seater backup EV van #2 at 08:15 AM",
    "Cap standing riders to 4 passengers maximum"
  ],
  "auditTimestamp": "2026-11-21T08:30:00Z"
}";
return [{ json: { prompt: prompt.replace("__DATA__", JSON.stringify(item, null, 2)), originalInput: item } }];
